run_pump_generator: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
convert_pump_source: convert a Pump meta-programming source text into generated C++ code using ConvertFromPumpSource
parse_pump_ast: parse Pump source text into an AST using ParseToAST for meta-programming analysis
tokenize_pump_code: tokenize Pump source code into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated C++ code by wrapping long lines with BeautifyCode
